Measurements needed: Repeated, analyte-specific PFAS concentrations in sediment, porewater where feasible, suspended solids, and overlying water
Why it is needed: Separates sediment inventory from dissolved and mobile fractions; avoids fitting one coefficient to mixed compartments. epa+1

Measurements needed: Fixed stations along the selected canal reach, upstream reference station, deposition zones, erosion zones, depth intervals, duplicate samples, and field blanks
Why it is needed: Establishes spatial heterogeneity, background, and reproducibility. EPA PFAS guidance includes sediment collection procedures and sampling-material precautions. epa

Measurements needed: Grain size, organic carbon, bulk density, porosity, moisture, mineralogy where relevant, CEC, pH, redox potential, ionic strength, and salinity/conductivity
Why it is needed: These properties affect PFAS sorption, partitioning, resuspension, and mobility. CEC requires laboratory analysis. epa+2

Measurements needed: Water level, stage, velocity/discharge, flow direction, shear-stress proxy, sediment deposition/resuspension observations, precipitation and storm-event timing
Why it is needed: Distinguishes apparent concentration loss from physical export, dilution, or resuspension.

Measurements needed: Diversions, releases, cleaning, dredging, maintenance, pumping, upstream discharge changes, and incident logs
Why it is needed: Identifies external inputs and physical disturbances that violate the closed-compartment assumption.

Measurements needed: Upstream and lateral inflow PFAS concentrations and flow-weighted loads; stormwater, outfalls, groundwater interaction if relevant
Why it is needed: Needed to estimate whether krk_rkr​ represents a continuing source rather than internal release.

Measurements needed: Baseline survey plus repeated sampling across dry periods, irrigation changes, storm events, maintenance events, and seasonal salinity conditions
Why it is needed: Avoids identifying a transient hydraulic shift as chemical decay.

Measurements needed: Method reporting limits, isotopic dilution where applicable, field blanks, equipment blanks, trip blanks, duplicates, matrix spikes, laboratory control samples, qualifiers
Why it is needed: PFAS sampling and analysis require contamination-aware QA/QC and analyte-specific method selection. epa+2

Measurements needed: Measurement uncertainty, censored-result treatment, replicate variance, parameter confidence intervals, residual diagnostics, and sensitivity analysis
Why it is needed: Prevents overconfident kdk_dkd​ and krk_rkr​ estimates.
